cases.name: reviewer_clean_run
cases.why: The reported bug: a Portfolio Review Agent finished with nothing to sell and the panel said '0 buys, 0 passes' — two counts for work a sell-only agent cannot do.

cases.name: reviewer_sold_one
cases.why: A real sale must not be flanked by '0 bought' and '0 passed'.

cases.name: buyer_bought_and_passed
cases.why: The ordinary buyer run still reads the way it always did.

cases.name: buyer_passed_on_everything
cases.why: A buyer that evaluated names and wanted none reports the passes, not a phantom '0 buys'.

cases.name: swarm_all_three
cases.why: A full swarm round — order is always buy, sell, pass.
cases.sentence: Run complete in 6:47 — 3 buys, 2 sells, 21 passes.

cases.name: singulars
cases.why: One of each — every noun and chip must be singular.
cases.sentence: Run complete in 0:58 — 1 buy, 1 sell, 1 pass.
